name: jev-gate
description: Claude Code plugins from the jev-gate repository: an instant extractive compactor, a Jev model and effort router, and the Jev orchestration gate. Each is off by default until you enable it.

plugins.name: jev-gate-compact
plugins.description: Answers auto compactions with an extractive digest and the recent tail: no summarizer request, milliseconds instead of a minute. Calls no Jev. Needs CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_FUNCTION_HOOKS=1; off until enabled.

plugins.name: jev-gate-router
plugins.description: Chooses the main thread's effort and each subagent's model and effort from one TypeSafe Jev assessment, and stays native on any doubt; the main thread's model is not routed. Needs CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_FUNCTION_HOOKS=1 and a TypeSafe key; off until enabled.

plugins.name: jev-gate
plugins.description: Jev-directed orchestration for deep sessions: a planner and tiered workers, admitted only past a context-depth floor. Built from the tagged release; needs Node 22 and a TypeSafe key.
